items.assumptions: 已证明任意拓扑空间上真实阿贝尔群层的有限点邻域余极限下降，不再假设所选点检测整个环境空间的开覆盖。仿射几何端点取任意交换环 A、实际 S=Spec(Localization(outside_primes sigma))、有限实际点族 q 穷尽 S 的闭点、环境 Spec A 上的真实层；闭点穷尽由题给闭点枚举对应，未要求环境点闭、域完美或局部谱为开。
quantifiers: MathGauge.PublicProof.Semilocal.finite_point_scheme: {R : Type u_1} → [inst : CommRing R] → Finset (PrimeSpectrum R) → AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme
MathGauge.PublicProof.Semilocal.finite_point_scheme_finite_closed: ∀ {R : Type u_1} [inst : CommRing R] (sigma : Finset (PrimeSpectrum R)), sigma.Nonempty → {x | IsClosed {x}}.Finite
MathGauge.PublicProof.Semilocal.finite_point_scheme_nonempty_closed: ∀ {R : Type u_1} [inst : CommRing R] (sigma : Finset (PrimeSpectrum R)), sigma.Nonempty → {x | IsClosed {x}}.Nonempty

MathGauge.PublicProof.Semilocal.finite_point_scheme_open_eq_top: ∀ {R : Type u_1} [inst : CommRing R] (sigma : Finset (PrimeSpectrum R))
  (U : (MathGauge.PublicProof.Semilocal.finite_point_scheme sigma).Opens),
  (∀ (x : ↥(MathGauge.PublicProof.Semilocal.finite_point_scheme sigma)), IsClosed {x} → x ∈ U) → U = ⊤
MathGauge.GP003.pairIntersection: {X : TopCat} → (x y : ↑X) → CategoryTheory.Functor (MathGauge.GP003.PairNeighborhoods x y) (TopologicalSpace.Opens ↑X)ᵒᵖ
MathGauge.GP003.overlapValue: {X : TopCat} → TopCat.Presheaf AddCommGrpCat X → ↑X → ↑X → AddCommGrpCat
MathGauge.GP003.leftOverlapMap: {X : TopCat} → (F : TopCat.Presheaf AddCommGrpCat X) → (x y : ↑X) → F.stalk x ⟶ MathGauge.GP003.overlapValue F x y
MathGauge.GP003.rightOverlapMap: {X : TopCat} → (F : TopCat.Presheaf AddCommGrpCat X) → (x y : ↑X) → F.stalk y ⟶ MathGauge.GP003.overlapValue F x y

MathGauge.GP003.leftOverlapMap_germ: ∀ {X : TopCat} (F : TopCat.Presheaf AddCommGrpCat X) (x y : ↑X) (U : TopologicalSpace.OpenNhds x)
  (V : TopologicalSpace.OpenNhds y),
  CategoryTheory.CategoryStruct.comp (F.germ (↑U) x ⋯) (MathGauge.GP003.leftOverlapMap F x y) =
    CategoryTheory.CategoryStruct.comp (F.map (CategoryTheory.homOfLE ⋯).op)
      (CategoryTheory.Limits.colimit.ι ((MathGauge.GP003.pairIntersection x y).comp F) (Opposite.op U, Opposite.op V))

MathGauge.GP003.rightOverlapMap_germ: ∀ {X : TopCat} (F : TopCat.Presheaf AddCommGrpCat X) (x y : ↑X) (U : TopologicalSpace.OpenNhds x)
  (V : TopologicalSpace.OpenNhds y),
  CategoryTheory.CategoryStruct.comp (F.germ (↑V) y ⋯) (MathGauge.GP003.rightOverlapMap F x y) =
    CategoryTheory.CategoryStruct.comp (F.map (CategoryTheory.homOfLE ⋯).op)
      (CategoryTheory.Limits.colimit.ι ((MathGauge.GP003.pairIntersection x y).comp F) (Opposite.op U, Opposite.op V))

MathGauge.GP003.overlap_eq_refinement: ∀ {X : TopCat} (F : TopCat.Presheaf AddCommGrpCat X) (x y : ↑X) (U : TopologicalSpace.OpenNhds x)
  (V : TopologicalSpace.OpenNhds y) (a : ↑(F.obj (Opposite.op ↑U))) (b : ↑(F.obj (Opposite.op ↑V))),
  (CategoryTheory.ConcreteCategory.hom (MathGauge.GP003.leftOverlapMap F x y))
        ((CategoryTheory.ConcreteCategory.hom (F.germ (↑U) x ⋯)) a) =
      (CategoryTheory.ConcreteCategory.hom (MathGauge.GP003.rightOverlapMap F x y))
        ((CategoryTheory.ConcreteCategory.hom (F.germ (↑V) y ⋯)) b) →
    ∃ W Z,
      ∃ (hWU : ↑W ≤ ↑U) (hZV : ↑Z ≤ ↑V),
        (CategoryTheory.ConcreteCategory.hom (F.map (CategoryTheory.homOfLE ⋯).op)) a =
          (CategoryTheory.ConcreteCategory.hom (F.map (CategoryTheory.homOfLE ⋯).op)) b

MathGauge.GP003.finite_point_germs_injective: ∀ {X : TopCat} {ι : Type u} (x : ι → ↑X),
  (∀ (W : TopologicalSpace.Opens ↑X), (∀ (i : ι), x i ∈ W) → W = ⊤) →
    ∀ (G : TopCat.Sheaf AddCommGrpCat X),
      Function.Injective fun a i =>
        (CategoryTheory.ConcreteCategory.hom (TopCat.Presheaf.germ G.obj ⊤ (x i) True.intro)) a

MathGauge.GP003.finite_point_germs_glue: ∀ {X : TopCat} {ι : Type u} (x : ι → ↑X),
  (∀ (W : TopologicalSpace.Opens ↑X), (∀ (i : ι), x i ∈ W) → W = ⊤) →
    ∀ [Finite ι] (G : TopCat.Sheaf AddCommGrpCat X) (a : (i : ι) → ↑(TopCat.Presheaf.stalk G.obj (x i))),
      (∀ (i j : ι),
          (CategoryTheory.ConcreteCategory.hom (MathGauge.GP003.leftOverlapMap G.obj (x i) (x j))) (a i) =
            (CategoryTheory.ConcreteCategory.hom (MathGauge.GP003.rightOverlapMap G.obj (x i) (x j))) (a j)) →
        ∃! b, ∀ (i : ι), (CategoryTheory.ConcreteCategory.hom (TopCat.Presheaf.germ G.obj ⊤ (x i) True.intro)) b = a i

MathGauge.GP003.germFamily: {X : TopCat} →
  {ι : Type u} →
    (x : ι → ↑X) → (F : TopCat.Presheaf AddCommGrpCat X) → ↑(F.obj (Opposite.op ⊤)) →+ (i : ι) → ↑(F.stalk (x i))

MathGauge.GP003.overlapDifference: {X : TopCat} →
  {ι : Type u} →
    (x : ι → ↑X) →
      (F : TopCat.Presheaf AddCommGrpCat X) →
        ((i : ι) → ↑(F.stalk (x i))) →+ (i j : ι) → ↑(MathGauge.GP003.overlapValue F (x i) (x j))

MathGauge.GP003.finite_point_descent_exact: ∀ {X : TopCat} {ι : Type u} (x : ι → ↑X),
  (∀ (W : TopologicalSpace.Opens ↑X), (∀ (i : ι), x i ∈ W) → W = ⊤) →
    ∀ [Finite ι] (G : TopCat.Sheaf AddCommGrpCat X),
      Function.Injective ⇑(MathGauge.GP003.germFamily x G.obj) ∧
        Function.Exact ⇑(MathGauge.GP003.germFamily x G.obj) ⇑(MathGauge.GP003.overlapDifference x G.obj)
finite_neighborhood_descent_exact: 对任意 TopCat X、有限索引 ι、x:ι→X 及实际阿贝尔群层 G，实际 neighborhood_value G (range x) 到 stalk 乘积的典范同态单射，且其像恰为 pair-overlap difference 的核；不需要 x 覆盖环境 X。

affine_semilocal_descent_exact: 对任意 CommRing A、sigma:Finset(PrimeSpectrum A)、q:ι→PrimeSpectrum(semilocalRing sigma)、Finite ι，以及 ∀z,IsClosed{z}→z∈range q 和真实环境层 G，actualRestrictionFamily q G.obj 单射，且 Function.Exact actualRestrictionFamily actualOverlapDifference。
localRingAmbientEquiv 对任意实际 S 点 q 给 A_(q∩A) ≃ₐ[A] (M⁻¹A)_q，algebraMap 交换；localFiberTensorIso 给真实 Scheme.pullback ≅ Spec((M⁻¹A)_q ⊗_(M⁻¹A) (M⁻¹A)_r)，有实际投影公式。
SchemeNeighborhoods f 的索引是实际 T→U→X 开概形因子分解；factors_open_iff_range / schemeNeighborhood_lift_unique 证明其与像的开邻域索引等价，并给实际 colimit 同构与代表元公式。
items.domains: 实际 Spec(Localization)、其真局部环 Spec、实际 Scheme.pullback 及 Spec tensor product；实际开概形因子分解范畴、真实 filtered Ab colimits、stalks、限制和两投影诱导同态。
items.conclusions: 给定仿射半局部化呈现时，题给真实 S、S_i、S_i×_S S_j 的开邻域呈现值及真正限制箭头满足等化子；全部对象和箭头比较已证明。完整原拟射影 X 的仿射呈现接口仍未证明，故阶段保持 partial。
items.representation: 不是把概形重命名为其像：先构造真实局部环和 scheme fiber product / tensor iso，再以开浸入唯一提升证明实际因子分解邻域与像邻域等价。用 prime-disjoint theorem 证明共同一般化邻域可由 U_i∩U_j 细化（包括空交），得 actualFiberValueIso。最后逐个代表元证明 actualRestrictionFamily_germ 和左右 fiberRestriction_overlap，搬运真实 finite_neighborhood_descent_exact。
gaps: 任意光滑拟射影原 X 的有限点共同仿射邻域存在性及原 X 上层限制到该仿射图的完整典范呈现比较尚未形式化。当前仿射端点已闭合实际局部环、fiber product、open-factorization colimit 与全部限制箭头，不再将这些已完成子项列为缺口。

items.assumptions: 给定真实仿射半局部化 S、两个不同实际闭点 q/r 穷尽闭点；H 是原环境谱上的真实预层，G 是原环境谱上的真实层，η 是原预层态射。实际 S 及所有所用实际开子概形的邻域延拓η单射，实际 S_q/S_r 的η满射（比题给同构弱）；仅题给分离二覆盖成功缩小后的 exact row。未假设延拓为层、未假设原未收缩覆盖正合或交叠比较满射。
quantifiers:
MathGauge.GP003.twoOpenRestriction: {X : TopCat} →
  (H : TopCat.Presheaf AddCommGrpCat X) →
    (U V : TopologicalSpace.Opens ↑X) → ↑(H.obj (Opposite.op ⊤)) →+ ↑(H.obj (Opposite.op U)) × ↑(H.obj (Opposite.op V))

MathGauge.GP003.twoOpenDifference: {X : TopCat} →
  (H : TopCat.Presheaf AddCommGrpCat X) →
    (U V : TopologicalSpace.Opens ↑X) →
      ↑(H.obj (Opposite.op U)) × ↑(H.obj (Opposite.op V)) →+ ↑(H.obj (Opposite.op (U ⊓ V)))

MathGauge.GP003.local_representative_of_stalk_surjective: ∀ {X : TopCat} {H G : TopCat.Presheaf AddCommGrpCat X} (η : H ⟶ G) (x : ↑X),
  Function.Surjective ⇑(CategoryTheory.ConcreteCategory.hom ((TopCat.Presheaf.stalkFunctor AddCommGrpCat x).map η)) →
    ∀ (b : ↑(G.obj (Opposite.op ⊤))),
      ∃ U,
        ∃ (_ : x ∈ U),
          ∃ a,
            (CategoryTheory.ConcreteCategory.hom (η.app (Opposite.op U))) a =
              (CategoryTheory.ConcreteCategory.hom (G.map (CategoryTheory.homOfLE ⋯).op)) b

MathGauge.GP003.restrict_lift: ∀ {X : TopCat} {H G : TopCat.Presheaf AddCommGrpCat X} (η : H ⟶ G) {U W : TopologicalSpace.Opens ↑X} (hWU : W ≤ U)
  {a : ↑(H.obj (Opposite.op U))} {b : ↑(G.obj (Opposite.op ⊤))},
  (CategoryTheory.ConcreteCategory.hom (η.app (Opposite.op U))) a =
      (CategoryTheory.ConcreteCategory.hom (G.map (CategoryTheory.homOfLE ⋯).op)) b →
    (CategoryTheory.ConcreteCategory.hom (η.app (Opposite.op W)))
        ((CategoryTheory.ConcreteCategory.hom (H.map (CategoryTheory.homOfLE hWU).op)) a) =
      (CategoryTheory.ConcreteCategory.hom (G.map (CategoryTheory.homOfLE ⋯).op)) b

MathGauge.GP003.comparison_two_closed_points: ∀ {X : TopCat} (x y : ↑X),
  x ≠ y →
    IsClosed {x} →
      IsClosed {y} →
        (∀ (W : TopologicalSpace.Opens ↑X), x ∈ W → y ∈ W → W = ⊤) →
          ∀ (H : TopCat.Presheaf AddCommGrpCat X) (G : TopCat.Sheaf AddCommGrpCat X) (η : H ⟶ G.obj),
            (∀ (W : TopologicalSpace.Opens ↑X),
                Function.Injective ⇑(CategoryTheory.ConcreteCategory.hom (η.app (Opposite.op W)))) →
              Function.Surjective
                  ⇑(CategoryTheory.ConcreteCategory.hom ((TopCat.Presheaf.stalkFunctor AddCommGrpCat x).map η)) →
                Function.Surjective
                    ⇑(CategoryTheory.ConcreteCategory.hom ((TopCat.Presheaf.stalkFunctor AddCommGrpCat y).map η)) →
                  (∀ (U₀ V : TopologicalSpace.Opens ↑X),
                      MathGauge.PublicProof.Semilocal.Separates {x} {y} U₀ V →
                        U₀ ⊔ V = ⊤ →
                          ∃ U ≤ U₀,
                            U ⊔ V = ⊤ ∧
                              Function.Exact ⇑(MathGauge.GP003.twoOpenRestriction H U V)
                                ⇑(MathGauge.GP003.twoOpenDifference H U V)) →
                    Function.Bijective ⇑(CategoryTheory.ConcreteCategory.hom (η.app (Opposite.op ⊤)))

actual_affine_two_closed_comparison: 任意 CommRing A、sigma、实际S的两个不同闭点q/r且∀z,IsClosed{z}→z=q∨z=r；对原环境的H、真实层G、η:H→G，假定schemeNeighborhoodMap在S与所有实际opens上单射、在真实localScheme q/r上满射，并对每个分离(q,r)二开覆盖存在仍覆盖的U≤U0使schemeTwoOpenRestriction / schemeTwoOpenDifference正合；则实际schemeNeighborhoodMap(semilocalToAmbient sigma)η双射。
actual_local_representative: 任意q及上述原η，真实localScheme q的比较满射蕴含：对任意真实G(S)邻域类b，存在实际S开集U含q和真实H(U)邻域类a，η_U(a)=b|U。无需把b假定为原环境全空间截面。
actual_two_open_uniqueness: 对真实环境层G，两个实际S开集U/V覆盖S且同一对闭点穷尽，则G(S)两元素在G(U)、G(V)限制相等蕴含本身相等；由已证明实际局部谱下降推出，不以延拓层性质为假设。
items.domains: 原环境谱上的实际H/G/η；真实S、实际开子概形U与U∩V、实际局部谱S_i的开概形因子分解colimit及典范比较/限制映射。
items.conclusions: actual_affine_two_closed_comparison 已在给定仿射半局部化呈现上证明原η的真实邻域延拓η_S双射。一般原光滑拟射影X到该仿射呈现的完整接口仍未形式化，因此整个S2保持partial。
items.representation: schemeNeighborhoodMap是原η的实际whiskered colim.map；schemeOpenRestriction/LE来自实际开浸入及scheme.homOfLE。actualLocalValueIso_naturality连接真实局部值比较和ambient stalk map；actual_local_representative用原germ代表及真正共同缩小选lift。剔除另一实际闭点，调用题给成功缩小exact row，再由S1的实际两开限制唯一性推出全局双射。
gaps: 实际仿射S上的原H/G邻域延拓、原η、局部/开交限制与成功收缩比较现已闭合。尚缺任意原光滑拟射影X的共同仿射邻域存在，以及原X的预层/层/η限制到该仿射图的完整典范呈现比较；该普通接口与S5 transfer几何分开记录。

items.assumptions: 任意拓扑空间、W 是包含指定点集 s 的实际开集；结论更一般地不要求 s 有限或非空。
quantifiers: MathGauge.GP003.RestrictedNeighborhoods: {X : TopCat} → Set ↑X → TopologicalSpace.Opens ↑X → Type (max 0 u)

MathGauge.GP003.restrictedInclusion: {X : TopCat} →
  (s : Set ↑X) →
    (W : TopologicalSpace.Opens ↑X) →
      CategoryTheory.Functor (MathGauge.GP003.RestrictedNeighborhoods s W)
        (MathGauge.PublicProof.Semilocal.SetNeighborhoods s)

MathGauge.GP003.intersectNeighborhood: {X : TopCat} →
  (s : Set ↑X) →
    (W : TopologicalSpace.Opens ↑X) →
      s ⊆ ↑W →
        CategoryTheory.Functor (MathGauge.PublicProof.Semilocal.SetNeighborhoods s)
          (MathGauge.GP003.RestrictedNeighborhoods s W)

MathGauge.GP003.inclusionIntersectionAdjunction: {X : TopCat} →
  (s : Set ↑X) →
    (W : TopologicalSpace.Opens ↑X) →
      (hsW : s ⊆ ↑W) → MathGauge.GP003.restrictedInclusion s W ⊣ MathGauge.GP003.intersectNeighborhood s W hsW
MathGauge.GP003.restrictedInclusion_final: ∀ {X : TopCat} (s : Set ↑X) (W : TopologicalSpace.Opens ↑X), s ⊆ ↑W → (MathGauge.GP003.restrictedInclusion s W).op.Final

MathGauge.GP003.exists_restricted_refinement: ∀ {X : TopCat} (s : Set ↑X) (W : TopologicalSpace.Opens ↑X),
  s ⊆ ↑W → ∀ (U : MathGauge.PublicProof.Semilocal.SetNeighborhoods s), ∃ V, ↑V ≤ U
MathGauge.GP003.restrictedNeighborhoodValue: {X : TopCat} → Set ↑X → TopologicalSpace.Opens ↑X → TopCat.Presheaf AddCommGrpCat X → AddCommGrpCat

MathGauge.GP003.restrictedNeighborhoodComparison: {X : TopCat} →
  (s : Set ↑X) →
    (W : TopologicalSpace.Opens ↑X) →
      (F : TopCat.Presheaf AddCommGrpCat X) →
        MathGauge.GP003.restrictedNeighborhoodValue s W F ⟶ MathGauge.PublicProof.Semilocal.neighborhood_value F s

MathGauge.GP003.restrictedNeighborhoodComparison_isIso: ∀ {X : TopCat} (s : Set ↑X) (W : TopologicalSpace.Opens ↑X),
  s ⊆ ↑W →
    ∀ (F : TopCat.Presheaf AddCommGrpCat X),
      CategoryTheory.IsIso (MathGauge.GP003.restrictedNeighborhoodComparison s W F)

MathGauge.GP003.restrictedNeighborhoodIso: {X : TopCat} →
  (s : Set ↑X) →
    (W : TopologicalSpace.Opens ↑X) →
      s ⊆ ↑W →
        (F : TopCat.Presheaf AddCommGrpCat X) →
          MathGauge.GP003.restrictedNeighborhoodValue s W F ≅ MathGauge.PublicProof.Semilocal.neighborhood_value F s

MathGauge.GP003.restrictedNeighborhoodComparison_representative: ∀ {X : TopCat} (s : Set ↑X) (W : TopologicalSpace.Opens ↑X) (F : TopCat.Presheaf AddCommGrpCat X)
  (U : MathGauge.GP003.RestrictedNeighborhoods s W),
  CategoryTheory.CategoryStruct.comp
      (CategoryTheory.Limits.colimit.ι
        ((MathGauge.GP003.restrictedInclusion s W).op.comp
          ((MathGauge.PublicProof.Semilocal.neighborhood_inclusion s).op.comp F))
        (Opposite.op U))
      (MathGauge.GP003.restrictedNeighborhoodComparison s W F) =
    CategoryTheory.Limits.colimit.ι ((MathGauge.PublicProof.Semilocal.neighborhood_inclusion s).op.comp F)
      (Opposite.op ↑U)
items.domains: s 的全部开邻域，与其中包含于 W 的开邻域的真实反序范畴；任意实际反变阿贝尔群预层。
items.conclusions: 证明 restricted inclusion 在限制方向为 final，给典范 colimit comparison 的 isIso、实际同构与代表元公式。
items.representation: U↦U∩W 是 inclusion 的右伴随；该具体相交映射给出余终性，典范同构保持实际限制映射。

items.assumptions: 任意域 k；实际 X=Spec k[t]、原点单点集、W=D(t)。

items.domains: 实际 Scheme、平滑结构态射、积分及仿射实例，真实 prime spectrum/Zariski opens。
items.conclusions: 给满足全部条件的反例：W 稠密开但不含原点，受限邻域类别为空，故不是 final。
items.representation: 使用 Polynomial.eval₂RingHom 得原点，不用抽象占位空间；final 的逗号范畴非空性与空类别直接冲突。

items.assumptions: 当前一般环的有限素理想局部化及任意小位点预层引理保持原条件；未构造完整 frozen-pin Cor_k 或以隐含转移假设替代。
quantifiers: MathGauge.PublicProof.Semilocal.outside_primes: {R : Type u_1} → [inst : CommRing R] → Finset (PrimeSpectrum R) → Submonoid R
MathGauge.PublicProof.Semilocal.finite_prime_localization: {R : Type u_1} → [inst : CommRing R] → Finset (PrimeSpectrum R) → Type u_1

MathGauge.PublicProof.Semilocal.disjoint_outside_primes_iff: ∀ {R : Type u_1} [inst : CommRing R] (sigma : Finset (PrimeSpectrum R)),
  sigma.Nonempty →
    ∀ (I : Ideal R), Disjoint ↑(MathGauge.PublicProof.Semilocal.outside_primes sigma) ↑I ↔ ∃ p ∈ sigma, I ≤ p.asIdeal

MathGauge.PublicProof.Semilocal.localization_spectrum_image_iff: ∀ {R : Type u_1} [inst : CommRing R] (sigma : Finset (PrimeSpectrum R)),
  sigma.Nonempty →
    ∀ (L : Type u_2) [inst_1 : CommRing L] [inst_2 : Algebra R L]
